name: teamchat_view
description: Return all unread teamchat messages visible to you, then advance your read cursor so the next call only shows newer messages. Use this when you receive a teamchat-summary heads-up at the top of your input ("[teamchat] Unread since …") to read the full content before replying. The output lists messages in chronological order with sender + timestamp + mentions; an empty inbox returns a fixed '[teamchat] No unread messages.' string.
